params.q: What is the GST rate on restaurant food in India?

search_parameters.q: What is the GST rate on restaurant food in India?

response.header: Most restaurants in India charge 5% GST without Input Tax Credit, while restaurants inside hotels with room tariffs of ₹7,500 or more charge 18% GST with ITC.

text_blocks.snippet: ✅ Standard GST Rates on Restaurant Food

list.snippet: Most standalone restaurants (AC or non‑AC) charge 5% GST without ITC 3 .
Takeaway food from regular restaurants also attracts 5% GST 2 .
Food supplied by Indian Railways/IRCTC is taxed at 5% without ITC 1 .

text_blocks.snippet: Restaurants located inside hotels where any room tariff is ₹7,500 or more must charge:
snippet_highlighted_words: inside hotels where any room tariff is ₹7,500 or more

list.snippet: 18% GST with ITC on restaurant food and beverages 3 .

text_blocks.snippet: This category is referred to as “specified premises” in GST rules Busy .

list.snippet: The 5% rate applies to keep dining affordable but disallows ITC for restaurants.
The 18% rate applies only to restaurants in higher‑end hotels, where ITC is allowed to offset costs 2 .

references.title: GST on Food and Restaurants: Rates, Rules and Impacts - ClearTax
references.snippet: Under GST, restaurants fall under the 5% GST rate, with no option to claim input tax credit (ITC) or the 18% GST rate, with ITC claims. This rate is decided depending on the location of the restaurant.

references.title: New GST for Restaurant 2026: 5% Rate on Restaurant Food & Services
references.snippet: The GST rate for most restaurant services in India is 5% without Input Tax Credit (ITC). Restaurant services supplied by hotels with applicable room tariff conditions may attract 18% GST with ITC as per applicable GST provisions.

references.title: GST on Food Items and Restaurants - Latest Rules and Rates
references.snippet: 5% GST is applicable to most restaurant services, including dine-in and takeaway, provided the restaurant does not claim Input Tax Credit (ITC). This is the standard restaurant GST rate applicable across most casual dining outlets.

references.title: GST on Restaurant Bill Calculator (2026): 5% vs 18%, With Alcohol Split
references.snippet: Most restaurants in India charge 5% GST on the food and beverage portion of the bill — made up of 2.5% CGST + 2.5% SGST — with no input tax credit. So on a food bill of ₹1,000 you pay ₹50 GST, for a total of ₹1,050.

references.title: GST on Restaurant Food in India: 5% vs 18% & Liquor VAT (2026)
references.snippet: What is the standard GST rate on restaurant food in India? The standard GST rate on restaurant food is 5% with zero Input Tax Credit (ITC) for the vast majority of establishments, including standalone dine-in restaurants, cafes, food trucks, takeaway counters, and delivery-only cloud kitchens.

references.title: GST on Restaurant Food 2026 – Rates by Type | GSTUtils
references.snippet: GST on Restaurant Food – Rates for Dine-in, Delivery & Hotels Restaurants in India charge 5% GST without Input Tax Credit. However, restaurants in 5-star hotels charge 18% with ITC. Food delivery apps like Swiggy and Zomato collect and pay GST at 5%.
